text: Each dot is one summer: the whole planet's average temperature.
For fifty years, her summers barely moved.
asr: For 50 years, her summers barely moved.

text: Then the dots began to climb, and they never came back down.
This summer, she turned one hundred. It was the warmest ever measured.
asr: This summer she turned 100. It was the warmest ever measured.

text: The next summer hasn't been drawn yet.
